messages.author: 639a8429af296535
messages.subject: Color adjust
parts:
Hello everyone

is it possible somehow to adjust color scale in image(file, mz = 222)? 
I want to compare several pictures, but if I draw them separately, they have a color scale with different limits.

Thanks

messages.author: 0246917cc53176d5
messages.subject: Re: Color adjust
parts:
Hi Marina,
I also had your issue and found that you can set the color scale limits by using the function zlim within the image function, like this:

image(file, mz = 222, zlim = c(0, 6000))

by setting the same zlim to all your images you can compare them with the same color scale.

Hope this helps! :)

Giulia

messages.subject: Re: Color adjust

Hi Marina,

another way would be as follow:
define mz to plot in vector format:
mzs <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
then set the layout and call normal;ize.image when plottng:
image(file, mz = mzs,  layout=c(2,3), normalize.image="linear")

hope this helps too,
Best

messages.author: 838579b7ba7e3ba2
messages.subject: Re: Color adjust
parts:
Hi Davide,

With normalize.image="linear",  you only get relative scale 0-1, the absolute intensity values are still different between MSI runs. 

Using zlim without setting normalize.image="linear" is the right solution. 

It will be great that Cardinal could support compare different MSI runs using the same relative scale.

Best,

Dong
